messages:
ravi_partnerships: Quick sync request 1014: Renewals wants a reseller-facing HW credit attached to private offers for committed spend. Key asks: pilot controls (invite-only), a clawback if usage < threshold within 12 months, and a simple billing mapping so SI can redeem. Any immediate red flags?

emma_sales: field asks this a lot. keep pilot small (3-5 customers) and make voucher redemption flexible for SI. Also need a customer-facing one-pager.

olga_legal: Clawbacks OK but must be in private-offer T&Cs. Some marketplaces won't allow post-settlement reversals; we'll need a per-marketplace exceptions list.

joe_billing: We can support voucher reconciliation but need these minimal fields:
```
private_offer_id, partner_id, voucher_id, voucher_amount_cents, clawback_threshold_pct, clawback_window_days
```
Marketplace settlement timing may delay clawbacks; we'll surface that in docs.

sam_si_ops: SI needs voucher to appear as invoice credit or reseller payout in our partner portal. We can handle redemption if partner_id mapping is provided. Portal UI should display voucher balance + expiry.

marketplace-bot: Docs added: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/reseller-hw-credit-guidance 10: includes sample private-offer payload and required metadata keys.

ravi_partnerships: Short pilot proposal:
- Invite-only private offers (max 5)
- Voucher cap: $15k per deal, one-time redemption to SI
- Clawback: if usage < 65% of committed spend in 12 months -> pro-rated reversal against invoices
- Redemption window: voucher redeemable within 9 months of execution
- Region gating: APAC/EU require legal clearance before including voucher

emma_sales: I'll draft one-pager + customer email templates and nominate pilot accounts.

olga_legal: I'll prepare T&C snippet and marketplace exceptions list.

joe_billing: I'll add the fields to billing ingestion and a sample mapping example.

sam_si_ops: I'll validate portal redemption flow and confirm partner_id schema.

ravi_partnerships: Great. Action items captured. Follow-up sync in 5 business days. :thumbsup:
